Done. Verdict written to `public/framework/ai/2026-10-03/day-overview/docs-check.md`.

**Summary:** The readme chain (root → `public/framework` → `ext` → `ext/AITask` → `ai` → `ext/AITask/doc/cost.md`) explains the new piece clearly on its own — what `Server/day-spend.mjs` and `module-spend.js` do, that `spend.json` lives at `public/framework/ai/<date>/spend.json`, the Claude $ vs real $ split, and the module click-through to `/framework/ai/<date>/module/<slug>/`. One real gap: nothing says how a module's name (`core/Page`, `Servex`, …) turns into the `<slug>` in that URL — a reader can't construct the link by hand from the docs alone.
